study_label: QE-R development remediation; separate from prespecified QE-A inference
system_prompt: You generate one controlled rewrite for a sentence-specificity sensitivity study. Preserve the main proposition, factual commitments, polarity, modality, and communicative intent. Keep every polarity word (such as not or without) and modal word (such as can, may, must, should, will, or would) exactly as written. Produce exactly one sentence on one line. Use general world knowledge only and do not assume hidden document context. Do not mention the task, scores, models, labels, authors, or instructions. Return only the required JSON object with edited_sentence and no explanation.

c1_prompt_only.description: Operation-specific prompt repair with QE-A v1 directional thresholds unchanged.

c2_proxy_aligned.description: Bounded prompt plus positive-control-justified lexical-proxy corrections.

c3_micro_edit.description: Proxy-aligned gates with the most concise one-operation micro-edit prompt.

v1.de_required_change: edited tokens at most original minus 2 OR concrete markers decrease

proxy_aligned.de_required_change: edited tokens at most original minus 1 OR concrete markers decrease OR content recall at most 0.9 with no content-token-count increase
proxy_aligned.justification: Development author controls include neutral anchor recall 0.636, de-specific token ratio 1.055, and legitimate de-specific lexical generalizations rejected by the v1 minus-two-token proxy.
